functions.name: break_into_debugger
functions.description: Does nothing in Halo: Reach's release build.

functions.name: debug_break
functions.description: Does nothing in Halo: Reach's release build.

functions.name: debug_force_player_view_count
functions.description: A debug function that does nothing in Halo: Reach's release build. Evidence suggests that in debug builds, it might have forcibly set the number of split-screen views to display.

functions.name: debug_print
functions.description: Presumably, if this were run in a debug build of Halo: Reach, it'd write a message to some readout or log file.

functions.name: debug_set_tracing_enabled
functions.description: Likely does nothing in Halo: Reach's release build.

functions.name: debugging_enable_tracing
functions.description: Likely does nothing in Halo: Reach's release build.

functions.name: get_random_object
functions.description: Used by Infection to move the active Haven. Will not select the same Haven twice in a row; if the map has only one Haven, then the containing trigger runs on every frame and spams "Hill Moved" announcements.

functions.name: rand
functions.description: Set a number variable to a random value greater than or equal to zero and less than the provided cap (i.e. [0, cap) as the range).

functions.name: set_scenario_interpolator_state
functions.description: Modify the "state" value of a scenario interpolator. Each scenario interpolator is defined by a "sirp" tag in the map file.

functions.name: end_round
functions.description: Ends the round. If the round limit is hit, ends the game as well.

functions.name: hs_function_call
functions.description: [MCC-only; backported from Halo 4.] Calls a HaloScript function that the map has made available for use by Megalo. This appears to be intended mainly for *.MAP mod authors who are creating map-and-Megalo combo mods.

functions.name: is_in_forge
functions.description: This condition is believed to test whether the current match is taking place in Forge. However, there is no known way to get gametype scripts to actually run in Forge.

functions.name: add_weapon
functions.description: Give a weapon to any biped, be it a player or an inanimate script-spawned Spartan, Elite, or Monitor. If the biped's owner player has Weapon Pickup disabled in their player traits, you must use "force" to add the weapon.

functions.name: apply_shape_color_from_player_member
functions.description: Used by KOTH FFA to set a Hill's shape color to the player that controls the Hill. Takes a single argument consisting of a globally-scoped object and a player member on that object.

functions.name: apply_upward_impulse
functions.description: Launches an object upward by a random amount. This is used for things like skulls popping out of heads in Headhunter.

functions.name: attach_to
functions.description: Attach one object to another. The subject will be moved to the target's position plus the offset before being attached. An additional parameter controls whether the offset exists in the target's reference frame (i.e. whether the target's rotation affects the subject's final position); however, the subject will not be rotated (to match the target or otherwise) even if a relative position offset is used.

functions.name: copy_rotation_from
functions.description: Have one object copy another object's rotation. The boolean argument indicates whether we copy all axes of rotation (true) or just the heading (false).

functions.name: create_object
functions.description: Creates an object. Note that even if the new object and/or the basis are non-solid, the new object may not be created exactly at the desired position. Attaching and detaching after the object is created is a more reliable way to ensure exact positioning when exact positioning is needed.

functions.name: delete
functions.description: Delete an object. If the deleted object is a player's current biped, then the player will respawn instantly; in limited-life game variants, they will not lose a life as a result of the deletion. Deleting a player's biped repeatedly for a prolonged period of time will cause the screen to cut to black for them; no HUD widgets will be visible, and most sounds will not be audible.

functions.name: detach
functions.description: Detach an object from any other object it is attached to.

functions.name: enable_spawn_zone
functions.description: Control whether a Respawn Zone is influencing spawning.

functions.name: face_toward
functions.description: Makes one object face toward another. Only seems to affect the subject's heading; pitch and roll rotations don't seem to occur. If you face an object toward itself, you can use the offset position to rotate it.

functions.name: get_carrier
functions.description: Set a player variable to the carrier of a weapon or Armor Ability. Testing reveals no cases where this function can fail (i.e. it behaves correctly for dropped objects, none-objects, and objects held by an NPC biped), but Bungie and 343i still manually clear the out-variable before calling it.

functions.name: get_distance_to
functions.description: Returns the distance between two objects. Returned distances are measured in feet; for a decent conversion to meters, multiply by 7 and divide by 23.

functions.name: get_orientation
functions.description: Retrieve the object's orientation as an enum between 1 and 6 inclusive, indicating which side of the object is facing up. This can fail, so you should consider resetting the number variable before calling this. Testing with vehicles indicates that the orientation indicates which of the object's local vectors (up, down, etc.) is most closely aligned with world-up, with the vectors numbered from 1 to 6 being: up (i.e. object is upright), left, backward (i.e. nose down), forward (i.e. nose up), left, and down (i.e. object is upside-down). However, testing with pre-placed and pre-rotated weapons and scenery objects always returned 1.

functions.name: get_speed
functions.description: Set a number variable to an object's speed. The speed is premultiplied by 10 and, if less than 0.1, returned as zero. The unit of measurement seems to be feet per second; Race multiplies by 109 and then divides by 100 to convert to kilometers per hour.

functions.name: has_forge_label
functions.description: Checks whether an object has a Forge label.

functions.name: is_of_type
functions.description: Checks an object's type.

functions.name: is_out_of_bounds
functions.description: Checks whether an object is out of bounds.

functions.name: kill
functions.description: Instantly destroy the specified object.

functions.name: place_at_me
functions.description: Creates an object. Note that even if the new object and/or the basis are non-solid, the new object may not be created exactly at the desired position. Attaching and detaching after the object is created is a more reliable way to ensure exact positioning when exact positioning is needed.

functions.name: place_between_me_and
functions.description: create_tunnel

functions.name: push_upward
functions.description: Launches an object upward by a random amount. This is used for things like skulls popping out of heads in Headhunter.

functions.name: remove_weapon
functions.description: Take a weapon from any biped, be it a player or an inanimate script-spawned Spartan, Elite, or Monitor.

functions.name: set_boundary
functions.description: Add a Shape to an object, or replace its existing Shape.

functions.name: set_fireteam_respawn_filter
functions.description: Limit which fireteams can spawn at an object.

functions.name: set_garbage_collection_disabled
functions.description: Set whether an object can be garbage-collected. This does not work if the object was created with the never_garbage_collect flag.

functions.name: set_hidden
functions.description: [MCC-only; backported from Halo 4.] Set whether an object is made invisible.

functions.name: set_invincibility
functions.description: Set whether an object is invincible. Invincible objects cannot be destroyed by anything -- even level boundaries.

functions.name: set_pickup_permissions
functions.description: Limit who can pick up a weapon. This action does not affect grenades, armor abilities, or vehicles.

functions.name: set_progress_bar
functions.description: Set whether an object displays a progress bar.

functions.name: set_respawn_filter
functions.description: Limit who can spawn at an object.

functions.name: set_scale
functions.description: Resizes an object. An enlarged object will correctly register hits from bullets and impacts with grenades (including being stuck), but splash damage will not take scaling into account and will apply (or not) based on the object's original size.

functions.name: set_shape
functions.description: Add a Shape to an object, or replace its existing Shape.

functions.name: set_shape_visibility
functions.description: Limit who can see an object's Shape.

functions.name: set_spawn_location_fireteams
functions.description: Limit which fireteams can spawn at an object.

functions.name: set_spawn_location_permissions
functions.description: Limit who can spawn at an object.

functions.name: set_waypoint_icon
functions.description: Control the icon of a waypoint on an object.

functions.name: set_waypoint_priority
functions.description: Control the priority of a waypoint on an object.

functions.name: set_waypoint_text
functions.description: Sets the text of an object's waypoint. Any variables used with a format string will be passed by reference, not by value, if the variable in question doesn't have network priority "high," and this may lead to results contrary to what you expect.

functions.name: set_waypoint_timer
functions.description: Set which timer an object displays, of the timer variables scoped to that object.

functions.name: set_waypoint_visibility
functions.description: Control the visibility of a waypoint on an object.

functions.name: set_weapon_pickup_priority
functions.description: Modify whether a weapon is picked up automatically or as a hold action. This only works on weapons, not grenades.

functions.name: shape_contains
functions.description: Checks whether one object is inside of another object's Shape. Note that this is a centerpoint check. If, for example, you check whether a shape contains a Warthog, the check will pass only when the Warthog's centerpoint is inside of the shape. If this check is run on an attached object, it will instead test the centerpoint of the parent object; for example, if A is attached to B, then A will only count as being in C's shape when B's centerpoint is in C's shape, regardless of the position of A's centerpoint.

functions.name: add_weapon
functions.description: This function attempts to add a weapon object to a player, without having to access their biped.

functions.name: apply_traits
functions.description: Apply one of the scripted sets of Player Traits to a player. There is no trigger action to remove a set of player traits; rather, you must reapply traits on every frame, and you "remove" traits by not reapplying them.

functions.name: assisted_kill_of
functions.description: Checks whether one player assisted in the slaying of another player. Note that players don't count as "assisting" themselves.

functions.name: force_into_vehicle
functions.description: Forces the player into a vehicle. The player is instantly teleported in. This action will not work if the player is already in a vehicle, or if the target vehicle is destroyed. It does work if the target vehicle is overturned, but the player will be instantly ejected without ever having spent any actual time in the vehicle.

functions.name: get_armor_ability
functions.description: Returns a player's armor ability.

functions.name: get_button_press_duration
functions.description: [MCC-only; backported from Halo 4.] A host-only action to retrieve how long (in milliseconds) a player has held a given button down. Intended for debugging purposes only; future MCC updates may change how this functions.

functions.name: get_button_time
functions.description: [MCC-only; backported from Halo 4.] A host-only action to retrieve how long (in milliseconds) a player has held a given button down. Intended for debugging purposes only; future MCC updates may change how this functions.

functions.name: get_crosshair_target
functions.description: Reportedly only works on objects that trigger a red reticle, and reportedly only on host.

functions.name: get_death_damage_mod
functions.description: Set a number variable to indicate what damage modifier killed a player.

functions.name: get_death_damage_type
functions.description: Set a number variable to indicate what damage type killed a player.

functions.name: get_fireteam
functions.description: Returns a player's fireteam number.

functions.name: get_killer
functions.description: Set a player variable to whoever most recently killed the target player.

functions.name: get_scoreboard_pos
functions.description: Get a player's position on the scoreboard, across all players and teams. This function returns 0 if the player used is (no_player).

functions.name: get_spree_count
functions.description: Returns the number of consecutive kills that a player has accomplished without dying.

functions.name: get_vehicle
functions.description: Sets an object variable to the vehicle that a player is currently using.

functions.name: get_weapon
functions.description: Returns a player's primary or secondary weapon, as desired.

functions.name: is_elite
functions.description: Checks whether a player is an Elite.

functions.name: is_fireteam_leader
functions.description: This function is a no-op and always returns false.

functions.name: is_monitor
functions.description: Checks whether a player is a Monitor.

functions.name: is_not_respawning
functions.description: Checks whether a player is NOT waiting to respawn.

functions.name: is_sangheili
functions.description: Checks whether a player is an Elite.

functions.name: is_spartan
functions.description: Checks whether a player is a Spartan.

functions.name: killer_type_is
functions.description: Checks what killed a player.

functions.name: record_griefer_penalty
functions.description: The specific function of this action is not known. Presumably it has something to do with keeping track of bad behavior in-game.

functions.name: set_biped
functions.description: Forces a player to use a specific object as their biped, leaving their original biped behind. This action does nothing if the chosen object is not a valid biped (i.e. the BIPD tag). Once a Megalo-spawned Spartan biped is assigned to a player, its voice will match the player's chosen Spartan gender regardless of the biped's own gender presentation.

functions.name: set_co_op_spawning
functions.description: Used in Halo: Reach's standard Race variant?

functions.name: set_fireteam
functions.description: Sets a player's fireteam number.

functions.name: set_loadout_palette
functions.description: Set which loadout palette a player or team has access to.

functions.name: set_objective_allegiance_icon
functions.description: Alters the icon of the title card shown at the start of a round.

functions.name: set_objective_allegiance_name
functions.description: Alters the description of the title card shown at the start of a round.

functions.name: set_objective_text
functions.description: Alters the text of the title card shown at the start of a round.

functions.name: set_requisition_palette
functions.description: Switches which Requisition Palette a player has access to. This functionality is not used in Halo: Reach.

functions.name: set_respawn_vehicle
functions.description: [MCC-only; backported from Halo 4.] Set which vehicle, if any, a player will respawn in.

functions.name: set_vehicle_spawning_enabled
functions.description: [MCC-only; backported from Halo 4.] Enable or disable vehicle spawning for a player. When enabled, the player will spawn in whatever vehicle you've set.

functions.name: try_get_death_damage_mod
functions.description: Set a number variable to indicate what damage modifier killed a player.

functions.name: try_get_death_damage_type
functions.description: Set a number variable to indicate what damage type killed a player.

functions.name: try_get_killer
functions.description: Set a player variable to whoever most recently killed the target player.

functions.name: get_scoreboard_pos
functions.description: Get a team's scoreboard position.

functions.name: has_any_players
functions.description: Checks whether a team has one or more players on it.

functions.name: set_co_op_spawning
functions.description: Co-op Spawning is more commonly known as "Bro Spawning," and is used in Invasion and in Bro Slayer.

functions.name: set_respawn_vehicle
functions.description: [MCC-only; backported from Halo 4.] Set which vehicle, if any, a team's players will respawn in.

functions.name: set_vehicle_spawning_enabled
functions.description: [MCC-only; backported from Halo 4.] Enable or disable vehicle spawning for a team. When enabled, the team will spawn in whatever vehicle you've set.

functions.name: is_zero
functions.description: Checks whether a timer is at zero.

functions.name: reset
functions.description: Resets a timer.

functions.name: set_rate
functions.description: Modify the rate at which a timer's value changes, and whether the value increases or decreases. If you set the timer to decrease, then its rate will automatically switch to 0% when it reaches zero. If you set the timer to increase, then it will not increase past its initial value unless its initial value is zero.

functions.name: set_icon
functions.description: Modify a HUD widget's icon.

functions.name: set_meter_params
functions.description: Modify meter options for a HUD widget. Any variables specified as part of the meter parameters appear to be passed by reference, which would mean that the meter will update as their values change, even if this action isn't run again.

functions.name: set_text
functions.description: Modifies the text for a HUD widget. You can stitch values together dynamically. Note that if you display a player's name by way of a player variable, the variable must have "high" network priority for the name to display properly off-host.

functions.name: set_value_text
functions.description: Modifies an unknown text field for a HUD widget. You can stitch values together dynamically.

functions.name: set_visibility
functions.description: Control whether a given player can see a HUD widget.
